prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a practical starting point: it tracks whether your business appears in answers on ChatGPT and several other AI search platforms, with entry pricing reported around **$25–$29/month**. It’s a monitoring tool, though—not a guarantee that AI engines will recommend you, and its prompt limits and engine coverage vary by plan.

If you’re a **local business**, also consider **BrightLocal’s Local AI Visibility Tracker**, which puts AI visibility alongside local SEO and Google Business Profile tools; it’s priced per location. For a free first check, **HubSpot AI Search Grader** offers a one-time diagnostic.

Before subscribing, check that the plan covers the AI engines and locations you care about, and that it lets you track realistic questions customers ask—such as “best [service] near me.” AI answers can vary by prompt, location, and time, so treat results as a trend rather than a definitive score.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
